_what: The forums' categories, in the order the forums list them. tools/make-forum.py writes them into netlify/cb/lib.mjs between the forum:categories markers, which is the only list the server reads. Do not hand-edit those markers; edit this and run tools/check-all.sh.
_brief: Ryan's brief, 2026-10-18: a forum after Discourse, for discussions that need to last more than the CB's day, with some of the channels from our Stoat and Discord, readable only by claimed usernames, a keep per category, and categories restricted by CB role for staff areas. The hope is that the CB and the forums together let us leave Discord and Stoat entirely.
_keep: How long a topic stays after its last post: "1 week", "3 months", "6 months" or "never". A topic with no keep of its own takes default_keep. Changing a category's keep here changes it for every topic already in it, because the date a topic goes is worked out every time it is read. A pinned topic is kept while it stays pinned. Ryan's calls, 2026-10-18: three months by default, and counted from the last post, so a living conversation never vanishes mid-discussion.
_roles: see: who can read the category, as CB_MODS roles (moderator, board, director, administrator); null is every claimed username. start: who can start a topic in it, as roles; null is everybody who can see it. An administrator sees and starts in every category unless it says strict, which is the Town Hall's Executive Session rule: the category's own roles are the only way in. A category somebody cannot see is never sent to them, and nothing says it exists.
_coping: Ryan's call, 2026-10-18: Coping is one of the most active channels on our Discord, so it is here for people moving over, and its topics go a week after the last post, because Discord keeps that channel for ever and that is not what it is for. Do not lengthen it to match the other categories.
_left_out: From the meeting hall's channels, left for Ryan or Helen to add: body doubling and the live rooms (those are calls, which every room on the street already has), and the gallery (the forums take words only, as the suggestion box does, until somebody decides how pictures of people's art are consented to).

categories.name: Announcements
categories.about: News from the people who run Stimpunks. Only moderators start a topic here; anybody can reply.

categories.name: Introductions
categories.about: Say hello, if you like, and say as much or as little as you want to. Reading along is a fine way to belong too.

categories.name: Help desk
categories.about: When something on the street, the CB or the forums does not work, or you cannot find your way.

categories.name: The watering hole
categories.about: Chat about anything, share penguin pebbles, pass the time. The CB for the things that need longer than a day, but not much longer.

categories.name: Coping
categories.about: For the hard days, and for getting through them together. Say what is going on and be met where you are; nobody has to fix anything, and nobody has to answer. What is said here stays here.

categories.name: Events
categories.about: What is coming up, and what happened: our calls, campfires, watch-togethers and anything else worth turning up for.

categories.name: Mutual aid
categories.about: To give help and to get it. Nobody owes anybody here.

categories.name: Show your work
categories.about: What you are making, writing, learning or fixing, finished or not.

categories.name: Work opportunities
categories.about: Jobs, gigs, calls for contributors and paid chances to do the work.

categories.name: Infodumps
categories.about: Tell us everything about the thing you love. Long is welcome.

categories.name: Reading, watching, listening, playing
categories.about: Books, films, shows, music, podcasts and games: what you are into and what you would pass along.

categories.name: Education
categories.about: Learning, schooling, unschooling and the places in between, and what they do to the people in them.

categories.name: Science and making
categories.about: Experiments, tinkering, crafts, code and anything built with your hands or your head.

categories.name: Nature
categories.about: Plants, animals, weather, places outdoors, and the ground you are standing on.

categories.name: Artificial Intelligence
categories.about: Learning, making and knowledge gardening with generative AI, and the arguments about it.

categories.name: Operations
categories.about: The work of running Stimpunks, out in the open, with room for anybody who wants to watch and learn.

categories.name: Editorial
categories.about: What we publish and how: drafts, edits, ideas for pages and the glossary.

categories.name: Moderators
categories.about: For our moderators: anything about keeping the street and the CB a good place to be.

categories.name: Directors
categories.about: For our directors, as the Directors' room off the Town Hall is.

categories.name: Board
categories.about: For the board, and the directors who join its meetings, as the Board room off the Town Hall is.
